text.en:
Any person violating section seventeen, Article VI, or subsection (2), section 11, Article VII, of
the Constitution of the Philippines, as amended, shall be punished by fine of not more than five thousand
pesos, or by imprisonment of not more than two years, or by both, and, in addition thereto, shall be subject to
such administrative or proper action.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 7, 1941
